description.en: Production-grade design system on shadcn/ui with Figma sync and AI components.
description.zh: 基于 shadcn/ui 的高完成度设计系统，API 完全兼容且与 Figma 原生同步。

content.en: SortUI is a modern design system and component library built on top of the shadcn/ui ecosystem, Base UI primitives, and Tailwind CSS. It maintains complete API and variant compatibility with shadcn/ui, enabling drop-in adoption or side-by-side usage without breaking existing code. Distributing components via the official @sortui CLI registry, it couples unified design tokens and dark mode with companion Figma UI kits, and includes both standard web primitives and specialized AI patterns like chat composers, prompt inputs, and trace views.
content.zh: SortUI 是一套基于 shadcn/ui 生态、Base UI 原语与 Tailwind CSS 构建的现代设计系统与 React 组件合集。它在底层严格保持与 shadcn/ui 相同的公共 API、参数及导出结构，支持零迁移成本的平替与混用。通过官方 @sortui 注册表实现 CLI 源码级按需引入，配合高度对齐的 Figma UI Kit 与统一设计令牌系统，不仅涵盖完备的基础控件，还原生提供了 AI 对话框、Prompt 输入与 Trace 追踪等高频 AI 交互组件。
